memory_candidates.content: In this repo, editing a .lean file's comment-only content (e.g. a module docstring) can still shift FormalSystem's tracked line count and trip the pre-commit hook's typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 (committed vs. live regeneration of typst/generated/status.typ). This is not a bypass case: the sanctioned remedy is `lake build && bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix`, then stage the regenerated status.typ alongside the real change. Expect this on ANY .lean edit that changes line count, not just substantive ones.

typst/FormalFoundations.typ cites Lean declarations two ways depending on register: #leansrc(module, name) for formal theorem-block citations (renders as module.name raw text), and plain backtick-wrapped raw text inline for prose-level declaration or doc-path citations (e.g. `docs/reference/axiom-reference.md`, `decide_sound`). When adding a prose citation to a Lean name or doc path in this paper, match the existing backtick convention rather than inventing a new citation style or always reaching for #leansrc.

When reconciling a repo-wide staleness claim across many prose surfaces (e.g. "no theorem X is proved" after X was later proved), a repo-wide grep sweep for the exact literal stale phrase (line-wrap tolerant, tr '\n' ' ' | grep -o) done at the START of a Phase-1-style re-verification step can surface genuinely out-of-scope "ninth surface" instances the task's own named surface list missed. Report these rather than silently expanding scope — they belong to a follow-up task.
